annotation.title_clean: Using Virtual Reality for scenario-based Responsible Research and Innovation approach for Human Robot Co-production
annotation.title_en: Using Virtual Reality for scenario-based Responsible Research and Innovation approach for Human Robot Co-production
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Aschenbrenner, D.; Van Tol, D.; Rusak, Z.; Werker, C.
annotation.venue: 3rd IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Virtual Reality (AIVR 2020)
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper proposing Virtual Reality scenarios within a Responsible Research and Innovation approach to explore stakeholder reactions to close human-robot collaboration in Industry 4.0 workplaces, aiming to design workspaces perceived as teamwork rather than a threat to jobs.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes VR scenarios to elicit stakeholder reactions to collaborative robots upfront
RRI requires investigating workers' thoughts and feelings when introducing new technology
Workers fear job loss from Industry 4.0 robots
Well-designed human-robot interaction can raise productivity and well-being, fostering a teamwork perception
